title.narrative: Strengthened capacities of constituents to generate evidence on labour market, foster rural economic growth, and ensure crisis-response through EIIP and Just Transition principles

description.narrative: The expected change is that Pakistan strengthens its institutional capacity to design and implement coherent, evidence-based employment policies that place decent work at the centre of economic transformation, climate action and crisis recovery. Government institutions will integrate employment objectives into macroeconomic, industrial and investment strategies while embedding just transition measures that promote green jobs, skills development, enterprise resilience and social protection, particularly for vulnerable groups. In crisis and fragile contexts, national actors will adopt employment-intensive approaches that protect livelihoods, sustain enterprises and reinforce social cohesion. Strengthened labour statistics and reliable labour market information systems will provide the data needed to guide policy choices and monitor job quantity, quality, gender equality and formalization outcomes, ensuring more inclusive, resilient and sustainable growth.
